_comment: Project settings for NavalAI. The repository is
The deny rules keep a session INSIDE the project: the global user file
~/.claude/CLAUDE.md is not project instructions and has previously sent
sessions chasing an external tool trio that has nothing to do with this
repository. CLAUDE.md in the project root is the authority.
WHAT CHANGED 2026-08-07, and why. This file used to DENY
'git push origin master*', 'git push * master', 'git push --force*' and
'git push -f *', and to ASK on every git push and git merge. That rule
was added to protect a shared tree being worked by several agents on
several branches at once - and that arrangement is exactly what was
retired today (see CLAUDE.md, Git protocol). With ONE branch there is no
shared-tree race to protect against, and a push guard that blocks the
only branch there is just stops work. The project owner's instruction is
explicit: one branch, master, always push to it.
git stash stays on ASK. That one is not bureaucracy: a stash in this
repo once swept up three agents' uncommitted work and recovered by luck.
